review_description: The best experience installer, good customer service easy to deal with. All great job

A  quality solution and installation  by a professional and knowledgeable team from quote to finish. I loved that I was dealing with the business owner not a commision paid salesperson. Mahesh did a great job understanding what our needs were and ensuring we got the most competitively priced  and highest output solution possible. I was disappointed with competitors quotes who were at least 30% higher than Best Green Solar whilst not providing as good a quality solution (based on the Solarquotes comparison tools) . I'd recommend you do your homework and if you get a quote from Best Green Solar you will not be disappointed. Installers were professional, punctual , tidy and finished on time without cutting corners. Panels look great and they are even arranging for a  smart meter with my energy provider ...one less thing for me to worry about

Best Green Solar has been very helpful with my solar installation. Mahesh gave me the best quote and always been available to clarify and provide advice even after 3 years after installation.I recently contacted Best Green solar to get some advise on Tesla 3 phase charger installation and then I came to know Mahehs was certified installer for Tesla as well. Straight signed up for the install and could never been happier with the quick and neat install.

I installed solar systems for two properties with this company, and I always find them very kind and skillful. They respond any questions promptly and they get the job done in time while assuring the best quality. Highly recommend.
Best service from consultation to fully installed and fully functional solar system. Very friendly, experienced and professional service. Best green solar is Highly recommended.

We had a fantastic experience with Mahesh for our solar panel installation. From start to finish, he was professional, knowledgeable, and attentive to our needs. They provided a detailed consultation, answering all our questions, and helped us choose the best system for our home. The installation process was seamless, and they completed everything on time with great attention to detail. We are already seeing significant savings on our energy bills and feel good about reducing our carbon footprint. Highly recommendBest Green Solar for anyone considering going solar

Best green solar always give you competitive quote and explain you about all the jobs in a clear way. They are well communicating, always reponse in a time and punctual. Well explained about the complete system and work flow of the solar system.
Quoting was good.Installation was smoothe, Basanta and Team was punctual, polite and so tidy.Overall, I am really happy with the service.
Best green solar was great from the start. They were professional, quick to respond and their work was efficient and clean. Would highly recommend them.

Best Green Solar installed my solar system. I contacted about 20 or so companies when I first started looking into solar energy to receive quotes. I ran into these individuals during that process. Mahesh, a man who was probably the owner, thoroughly explained everything to me about the solar system, and he provided me with a quote that was at least 20% less expensive than the market. I learned how polite and honest Mahesh and the Best Green Solar firm are when I spoke with other businesses after speaking with Mahesh (some of them tried to trick me). Nobody was even close in competition to Best Green Solar. It was no brainer for me to choose them. They installed it really promptly as well. Even in my dreams, I would recommend them because I am so happy with them!

Finn's recommended installers:1) Recommendation No 1: Spent no time to talk to us to find out what we wanted / needed and went ahead and quoted us a 'way over the top' system and price via email with no follow-up until last week (4 weeks later)2) Booked a Zoom call as suggested and were confronted with a sales spin on how good and reliable they were. Probably true, however, with that much back up and infrastructure, one would expect things to cost more, but their price  was DOUBLE to what everyone else was quoting. No thanks.We researched some suppliers ourselves and Finn's tips on what to ask, what to watch out for and also us 'pulling the advertised special apart', which involved inferior products then what we wanted etc and mostly (but not always) sales people, who were focussed on price only and being quite pushy to make quota I guess, some even claiming they were installing it, but on further push-back from me and interrogating them, found out they were simply sales people and the work was being outsourced, and this with 6 different suppliers we found on Google and Social Media.Anyway, through family who had 4 systems installed with helpful customer service by a qualified electrician/installer, who was about 30mins drive away, we got a fast quote/same day on a Saturday and he was completely transparent and non-pushy. We found he had excellent only 5 star Google reviews and he actually recommended new, better Jinko panels with more power (first and only supplier out of 8 who did!) and we had confidence that we were getting a good install.The deal wasn't the cheapest, but it was good value we thought and when one of our relatives had had a WIFI issue with the monitoring app, he had been available straight away to help fix the problem and he has been in business for 6+ years.System was installed last Thursday. Installers were polite, he was here himself, most of the day, on the roof, checking on things and submitted the paperwork to our electricity company whilst onsite. We're just waiting to get a new SmartMeter installed by Red Energy and then we'll switch over. Even went to the trouble to install the Inverter in the garage at no extra cost, so it wasn't exposed to the sun.So far, so good. Very happy.
